column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 07 (M24007): Ateraxis menawar pada Commander, AR Team bertempur,
# Chiloveig menyiapkan ritual Barracuda dengan Helena & Melanie sebagai medium.
# Tetap Inggris: Ateraxis, Asteria, Soppo, Robella, RO, M16, Beluga, AR Team, Commander,
# The Elmo, Mokosh, Nirvana, Lunasia, Jojo, Boojum, Paradeus, Chiloveig, Nyto, Helena,
# Melanie, Colphne, Vepley, Sextans, Groza, Voymastina, Barracuda, Avenger's Mark,
# Remolding Pattern, Persica, Caldwell, Frankfurt, Relics, Lviv, Ophelunie, Alva,
# Yellow Zone, Frame, Doll, M4, Holy Grail.
# Lagu Chiloveig dibiarkan berbahasa Italia sesuai aslinya.
Whatever you're trying to do... get the hell off my Elmo.
column2: Apa pun yang mau kau lakukan... enyah dari Elmo-ku.

column1: (Gale-force winds poured into the Elmo through the blasted opening. After being bombarded, the airtightness of the various rooms on the Elmo had significantly decreased. Standing in the corridor, I could even smell the faint scent of the Yellow Zone wind.)
column2: (Angin sekencang badai menyembur masuk ke Elmo lewat lubang hasil ledakan. Setelah dibombardir, kerapatan udara berbagai ruangan di Elmo menurun jauh. Berdiri di koridor, aku bahkan bisa mencium bau samar angin Yellow Zone.)

column1: (Ateraxis in front of me didn't move, just quietly looked at me.)
column2: (Ateraxis di depanku tidak bergerak, hanya menatapku dalam diam.)

column1: Commander, choose me.
column2: Commander, pilih aku.

column1: I don't understand what you mean.
column2: Aku tidak mengerti maksudmu.

column1: To some extent, I have already betrayed Mother.
column2: Sampai batas tertentu, aku sudah membelot dari Mother.

column1: You took in Big Sis Sextans, so you can take me in too, right?
column2: Kau menerima Big Sis Sextans, jadi kau bisa menerimaku juga, kan?

column1: Are you saying you betrayed your "Mother" and Paradeus?
column2: Kau bilang kau membelot dari "Mother" dan Paradeus?

column1: ...That joke is not funny at all.
column2: ...Lelucon itu sama sekali tidak lucu.

column1: It's true. Mother wants me to devour the Boojum cores that already have self-awareness to become a form more adapted to Nirvana. But I don't want to assimilate with any other consciousness, so whether it's third-generation Dolls, Jojo, or any other targets, I don't plan to 'eat' them.
column2: Ini benar. Mother ingin aku menelan inti Boojum yang sudah punya kesadaran diri supaya menjadi bentuk yang lebih cocok untuk Nirvana. Tapi aku tidak ingin berasimilasi dengan kesadaran lain, jadi baik Doll generasi ketiga, Jojo, atau sasaran mana pun, aku tidak berniat 'memakan' mereka.

column1: Although Mother is magnanimous and won't be dissatisfied with me because of this, I still want to enter Nirvana and face Lunasia, which will conflict with her plans.
column2: Meski Mother berlapang hati dan tidak akan kecewa padaku karena itu, aku tetap ingin masuk ke Nirvana dan berhadapan dengan Lunasia, dan itu berbenturan dengan rencananya.

column1: Even Mother probably wouldn't be able to forgive me.
column2: Mother pun kemungkinan tidak akan bisa memaafkanku.

column1: (Ateraxis clasped her hands in front of her chest and spoke to me sincerely. I suddenly realized—she was proposing conditions, negotiating with me.)
column2: (Ateraxis merapatkan kedua tangannya di depan dada dan berbicara padaku dengan sungguh-sungguh. Aku tiba-tiba menyadari—dia sedang mengajukan syarat, bernegosiasi denganku.)

column1: (Without a doubt, this was perhaps her first time doing such a thing.)
column2: (Tidak diragukan, ini mungkin kali pertama dia melakukan hal seperti itu.)

column1: I can help you take back Mokosh, Commander. That's not difficult at all.
column2: Aku bisa membantumu merebut kembali Mokosh, Commander. Itu sama sekali tidak sulit.

column1: I can kill all your enemies for you, except for Mother's people.
column2: Aku bisa membunuh semua musuhmu, kecuali orang-orang Mother.

column1: As long as you help me open the door to Nirvana, so I can see her.
column2: Asalkan kau membantuku membuka pintu ke Nirvana, supaya aku bisa menemuinya.

column1: Absolutely impossible.
column2: Sama sekali mustahil.

column1: Commander, you are great, but also very selfish.
column2: Commander, kau hebat, tapi juga sangat egois.

column1: You sit upon such a great sanctuary... yet you are unwilling to turn it into a miracle.
column2: Kau duduk di atas tempat suci yang begitu agung... tapi tidak mau mengubahnya menjadi keajaiban.

column1: You are willing to use your own flesh and blood to block the progress of life; yet you also want to bury the miracle that could answer everything in this ordinary land.
column2: Kau bersedia memakai darah dan dagingmu sendiri untuk menahan kemajuan kehidupan; tapi kau juga ingin mengubur keajaiban yang bisa menjawab segalanya di tanah biasa ini.

column1: Miracles...
column2: Keajaiban...

column1: Everyone wants to reproduce miracles, but no one cares about the consequences they will bring.
column2: Semua orang ingin mengulang keajaiban, tapi tidak ada yang peduli akibat yang dibawanya.

column1: You think I don't understand it, which is why I don't want to possess it, right?
column2: Kau pikir aku tidak memahaminya, karena itu aku tidak ingin memilikinya, kan?

column1: I know more about miracles than you do. God won't just wave a hand and solve the world's problems; God will only unleash consequences upon the world that humanity cannot bear.
column2: Aku lebih tahu soal keajaiban daripada kau. God tidak akan sekadar melambaikan tangan dan menyelesaikan masalah dunia; God hanya akan melepaskan akibat yang tidak sanggup ditanggung manusia.

column1: Last time in Lviv, if it weren't for a certain person's sacrifice, the opening of Nirvana would have only resulted in a massive tragedy, causing the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people.
column2: Waktu di Lviv dulu, kalau bukan karena pengorbanan seseorang, terbukanya Nirvana hanya akan berujung tragedi besar, menewaskan ratusan ribu orang.

column1: Humans, perhaps, cannot endure it.
column2: Manusia, mungkin, tidak sanggup menanggungnya.

column1: But, I am different...
column2: Tapi aku berbeda...

column1: Commander, I am strong.
column2: Commander, aku kuat.

column1: You have already seen my power.
column2: Kau sudah melihat kekuatanku.

column1: Mother said that I possess enough power to bear the complete knowledge of Nirvana.
column2: Mother bilang aku punya kekuatan yang cukup untuk menanggung pengetahuan Nirvana secara utuh.

column1: Didn't you say you betrayed her?
column2: Bukannya kau bilang kau membelot darinya?

column1: Yes, so, I don't intend to do as she wishes and become an existence that is an enemy to humans and mutually destructive.
column2: Benar, jadi aku tidak berniat menuruti keinginannya dan menjadi eksistensi yang memusuhi manusia lalu saling menghancurkan.

column1: (Ateraxis reveals a somewhat melancholy expression.)
column2: (Ateraxis menampakkan ekspresi yang agak muram.)

column1: (For some reason, her figure no longer seems so intimidating. For a moment, she seems to feel somewhat doubtful and uncertain about her own answer.)
column2: (Entah kenapa, sosoknya tidak lagi terasa begitu mengintimidasi. Sesaat dia tampak agak ragu dan tidak yakin dengan jawabannya sendiri.)

column1: For you, there's still time.
column2: Untukmu, masih ada waktu.

column1: It's a pity that your gentleness cannot save me as well, because from the very beginning, what I needed was not something this world could give.
column2: Sayang sekali kelembutanmu tidak bisa menyelamatkanku juga, karena sejak awal yang kubutuhkan bukan sesuatu yang bisa diberikan dunia ini.

column1: (I sighed and raised the gun in my hand, pointing it at Ateraxis, who was stepping onto The Elmo's gangway as if no one else was there.)
column2: (Aku mengembuskan napas dan mengangkat pistol di tanganku, menudingkannya ke Ateraxis yang melangkah ke jembatan The Elmo seolah tidak ada orang lain di situ.)

column1: (However, before I could pull the trigger, a gunshot rang out beside me.)
column2: (Namun sebelum aku menarik pelatuk, sebuah letusan berbunyi di sebelahku.)

column1: Stop joking around...
column2: Berhenti bercanda...

column1: (Asteria held her gun. The two bullets from just now were swatted away by Ateraxis, falling to the ground with two clinking sounds.)
column2: (Asteria menggenggam senjatanya. Dua proyektil tadi ditepis Ateraxis, jatuh ke lantai dengan dua bunyi nyaring.)

column1: Everyone wants to see her, but only we are not allowed to think that way...
column2: Semua orang ingin menemuinya, tapi hanya kami yang tidak boleh berpikir begitu...

column1: Only we are destined to never meet again in this lifetime...
column2: Hanya kami yang ditakdirkan tidak akan pernah bertemu lagi di hidup ini...

column1: This is really... too unfair...!
column2: Ini benar-benar... terlalu tidak adil...!

column1: I heard that a member of the AR Team became a part of "God."
column2: Kudengar salah satu anggota AR Team menjadi bagian dari "God."

column1: It seems there is still a connection between you two...
column2: Sepertinya masih ada kaitan di antara kalian berdua...

column1: Gods or no gods... I only know...
column2: Ada tuhan atau tidak... aku hanya tahu...

column1: You better stop... bothering her!
column2: Lebih baik kau berhenti... mengganggunya!

column1: ("Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat—")
column2: ("Tratatatatata—")

column1: (The bullets fired by Asteria traced an arc in the air, heading straight for several vital points on Ateraxis's body.)
column2: (Proyektil yang ditembakkan Asteria menarik busur di udara, langsung menuju beberapa titik vital di tubuh Ateraxis.)

column1: (At the moment the bullets were about to hit the target, Ateraxis swatted them away like shooing insects.)
column2: (Tepat saat proyektil itu hampir mengenai sasaran, Ateraxis menepisnya seperti mengusir serangga.)

column1: Stop doing useless things. Is that thing on your back just for show?
column2: Berhenti melakukan hal yang tidak berguna. Benda di punggungmu itu cuma pajangan?

column1: So annoying!
column2: Menjengkelkan sekali!

column1: (Asteria raises the "Avenger's Mark" on her back, and white light accumulates at the muzzle.)
column2: (Asteria mengangkat "Avenger's Mark" di punggungnya, dan cahaya putih berkumpul di ujung larasnya.)

column1: (Ateraxis appears behind her and presses down the barrel with one hand. Unexpectedly, Asteria immediately turns around, and the white-hot energy about to be fired turns into a blade and swings upward, cutting off a few strands of the other's hair and leaving a wound on Ateraxis's waist.)
column2: (Ateraxis muncul di belakangnya dan menekan larasnya dengan satu tangan. Tak terduga, Asteria langsung berbalik, dan energi putih membara yang hampir ditembakkan itu berubah menjadi bilah dan diayun ke atas, memotong beberapa helai rambut lawannya dan meninggalkan luka di pinggang Ateraxis.)

column1: —As expected.
column2: —Sudah kuduga.

column1: She gave this to you, didn't she?
column2: Dia yang memberikan ini padamu, kan?

column1: It's exactly for dealing with guys like you.
column2: Ini memang untuk mengurus orang sepertimu.

column1: (The deployed energy shield was torn apart like paper. Ateraxis didn't confront it head-on; she raised her right hand and smashed a punch into the ground beneath her feet.)
column2: (Pelindung energi yang dipasang itu tercabik seperti kertas. Ateraxis tidak melawan dari depan; dia mengangkat tangan kanannya dan menghantamkan satu pukulan ke tanah di bawah kakinya.)
（“Braak——”）

column1: (The heavy special steel plates emit a violent sound of tearing metal. In the next instant, beneath Asteria's feet, some pale tissue is rapidly hardening, suddenly rising from the ground like thorns growing in the wilderness.)
column2: (Lempeng baja khusus yang berat itu mengeluarkan suara logam tercabik yang ganas. Sesaat kemudian, di bawah kaki Asteria, jaringan pucat mengeras dengan cepat, tiba-tiba menyembul dari tanah seperti onak yang tumbuh di belantara.)

column1: (The moment Ateraxis touches the ground, Asteria has already made a leaping motion—but it's still too late. A white ground spike like a spear grazes her right side, directly tearing her bionic skin and exposing the muscle tissue inside.)
column2: (Begitu Ateraxis menyentuh tanah, Asteria sudah melakukan gerakan melompat—tapi tetap terlambat. Sebuah taji putih mirip tombak menyerempet sisi kanannya, langsung mencabik kulit bioniknya dan menyingkap jaringan otot di dalamnya.)

column1: (With a 'bang', she falls heavily onto the deck more than ten meters away and drops down.)
column2: (Dengan bunyi 'duk', dia terhempas keras ke dek lebih dari sepuluh meter jauhnya lalu terjatuh.)

column1: (I prepare to run over and help her up, but Ateraxis arrives in front of her first at a speed difficult for the naked eye to distinguish.)
column2: (Aku bersiap berlari menolongnya berdiri, tapi Ateraxis lebih dulu sampai di depannya dengan kecepatan yang sulit ditangkap mata.)

column1: (A large amount of pale tissue gathers, elongates, and expands between Ateraxis's wrists—)
column2: (Jaringan pucat dalam jumlah besar berkumpul, memanjang, dan mengembang di antara kedua pergelangan tangan Ateraxis—)

column1: (In the blink of an eye, a giant scythe had already formed in her hands.)
column2: (Dalam sekejap, sebuah sabit raksasa sudah terbentuk di tangannya.)

column1: Although you were given power, unfortunately, your Frame can't keep up with your reactions.
column2: Meski kau diberi kekuatan, sayangnya Frame-mu tidak sanggup mengikuti reaksimu.

column1: If you had third-generation Dolls, or a frame like Voymastina's, the battle would be a bit more interesting.
column2: Kalau kau punya Doll generasi ketiga, atau frame seperti milik Voymastina, pertarungannya akan sedikit lebih menarik.

column1: (Ateraxis raised her scythe high in an executioner's stance, but then she looked to the other side, staring straight at the other two Dolls charging towards her.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengangkat sabitnya tinggi dalam sikap seorang eksekutor, tapi kemudian dia menoleh ke arah lain, menatap lurus dua Doll lain yang menerjang ke arahnya.)

column1: Finally here?
column2: Akhirnya datang?

column1: Stop right there—you obnoxious jerk!
column2: Berhenti di situ—dasar menyebalkan!

column1: ('Bang!' 'Bang!' 'Bang!')
column2: ('Duar!' 'Duar!' 'Duar!')

column1: (Three high-explosive grenades, trailing smoke, smash precisely into Ateraxis's landing spot.)
column2: (Tiga granat berdaya ledak tinggi, menyisakan jejak asap, menghantam tepat titik pijakan Ateraxis.)

column1: (Deafening chain explosions erupt on the deck—the violent shockwaves mixed with scorching shrapnel instantly sweep the surroundings.)
column2: (Ledakan berantai yang memekakkan meletus di dek—gelombang kejut ganas bercampur pecahan membara seketika menyapu sekitarnya.)

column1: ("Rat-tat-tat-tat—")
column2: ("Tratatatata—")

column1: (The moment Soppo lands, even before she has time to cushion the impact, the assault rifle in her hands has already begun its frantic roar.)
column2: (Begitu Soppo mendarat, bahkan sebelum sempat meredam benturannya, senapan serbu di tangannya sudah mulai meraung liar.)

column1: (The container representing the Remolding Pattern continuously scattered light and gas. Even without saying it, Soppo knew how dangerous the person in front of her was.)
column2: (Wadah yang melambangkan Remolding Pattern itu terus menyemburkan cahaya dan gas. Tanpa perlu dikatakan pun, Soppo tahu betapa berbahaya orang di depannya.)

column1: Soppo, maintain suppressive fire!
column2: Soppo, jaga tembakan penekannya!

column1: 15—grab onto me!
column2: 15—pegangan padaku!

column1: (The distinctive rat-tat-tat of submachine guns rang out, weaving into a dense and highly targeted net of fire.)
column2: (Deretan letusan khas senapan mesin ringan berbunyi, merajut jaring tembakan yang rapat dan sangat terarah.)

column1: (This wasn't blind firing, but aimed at the cellular tissue spreading around Ateraxis's feet.)
column2: (Itu bukan tembakan buta, tapi diarahkan ke jaringan sel yang menyebar di sekitar kaki Ateraxis.)

column1: (A few ground spikes that had just emerged were accurately shattered by Robella. She slid over to Asteria and dragged her towards the cover in the back.)
column2: (Beberapa taji tanah yang baru menyembul dihancurkan Robella dengan tepat. Dia meluncur ke arah Asteria dan menariknya ke tempat berlindung di belakang.)

column1: Looks like there's no time to catch up.
column2: Sepertinya tidak ada waktu untuk mengobrol.

column1: Honestly, such an intense battle right from the start... hurry up and equip this.
column2: Yang benar saja, pertempuran sekeras ini dari awal... cepat pakai ini.

column1: Remolding Pattern... Persica really made it?
column2: Remolding Pattern... Persica benar-benar membuatnya?

column1: How do I use it?
column2: Bagaimana cara memakainya?

column1: Learn it slowly, doesn't it have a very AR Team style to it?
column2: Pelajari perlahan, gayanya sangat AR Team, kan?

column1: ("Click"—the sound of bullets being chambered rings out one after another.)
column2: ("Klik"—suara proyektil dimasukkan ke kamar peluru berbunyi satu demi satu.)

column1: (Ateraxis calmly watches the three Dolls regrouping and covering each other's flanks in front of her, then leaps backward lightly, landing on the wider deck of The Elmo.)
column2: (Ateraxis dengan tenang memperhatikan tiga Doll yang menata ulang formasi dan saling menutupi sisi di depannya, lalu melompat ke belakang dengan ringan, mendarat di dek The Elmo yang lebih lapang.)

column1: (The three followed closely behind, weaving a net of firepower with bullets around them. However, right at this moment, several blood-red 'vines' appeared one after another beneath their feet...)
column2: (Ketiganya mengikuti rapat di belakang, merajut jaring tembakan di sekeliling mereka. Namun tepat saat itu, beberapa 'sulur' merah darah muncul satu demi satu di bawah kaki mereka...)

column1: This guy is indeed...
column2: Orang ini memang...

column1: (Asteria didn't have time to explain, she could only try her best to dodge these wandering blood-colored thorns on the ground.)
column2: (Asteria tidak punya waktu menjelaskan, dia hanya bisa berusaha sekuat tenaga mengelak dari onak merah darah yang menjalar di lantai itu.)

column1: (Robella also barely dodged, but Soppo wasn't so lucky. A vine-like object wrapped around her ankle, trying to drag her entirely towards Ateraxis.)
column2: (Robella juga nyaris tidak sempat mengelak, tapi Soppo tidak seberuntung itu. Benda seperti sulur membelit pergelangan kakinya, mencoba menarik seluruh tubuhnya ke arah Ateraxis.)

column1: Waaah—what the heck is this!
column2: Huwaaa—apa-apaan ini!

column1: So gross!
column2: Menjijikkan!

column1: (Soppo swung her gunstock, trying to smash the things that kept slithering toward her.)
column2: (Soppo mengayunkan popor senjatanya, mencoba menghancurkan benda-benda yang terus menjalar ke arahnya.)

column1: (But these blood-red thorns seemed to have infinite regenerative power, their wounds healing rapidly. Soon, Soppo was entangled by these vines, unable to move.)
column2: (Tapi onak merah darah itu seolah punya daya regenerasi tanpa batas, lukanya menutup dengan cepat. Tak lama, Soppo terbelit sulur-sulur itu dan tidak bisa bergerak.)

column1: I'll help you!
column2: Aku akan membantumu!

column1: (Robella fired several bullets at Soppo's feet, trying to help her out.)
column2: (Robella menembakkan beberapa proyektil ke arah kaki Soppo, mencoba membebaskannya.)

column1: (However, Ateraxis had already arrived in front of her and casually raised her left hand.)
column2: (Namun Ateraxis sudah sampai di depannya dan mengangkat tangan kirinya dengan santai.)

column1: (*Swish*—)
column2: (*Wush*—)

column1: (A warblade mixed with dark red patterns appeared in her hand, instantly slashing Robella to the ground.)
column2: (Sebilah pedang perang bermotif merah gelap muncul di tangannya, seketika menebas Robella sampai jatuh ke lantai.)
Ugh——!

column1: It's your turn.
column2: Sekarang giliranmu.

column1: (As if it were just the next second, Asteria felt Ateraxis appear behind her.)
column2: (Seolah hanya sedetik kemudian, Asteria merasakan Ateraxis muncul di belakangnya.)

column1: (She reached out and lightly pressed against her chest—)
column2: (Dia mengulurkan tangan dan menekan ringan dadanya—)

column1: (Those blood-red thorns immediately spread around her, firmly pinning her to the deck.)
column2: (Onak merah darah itu langsung menyebar di sekelilingnya, memakunya kuat-kuat ke dek.)

column1: Commander, you saw it.
column2: Commander, kau melihatnya.

column1: (She ignored the bullets continuously fired from the pistol in my hand and came straight to me.)
column2: (Dia mengabaikan proyektil yang terus kutembakkan dari pistol di tanganku dan datang langsung ke arahku.)

column1: In the realm of violence, you and your Dolls are no different before me.
column2: Dalam ranah kekerasan, kau dan Doll-mu tidak ada bedanya di hadapanku.

column1: Will you hand those two girls over to me?
column2: Kau mau menyerahkan dua anak itu padaku?

column1: That's impossible.
column2: Itu mustahil.

column1: What a pity. Then I'll just have to find it myself—
column2: Sayang sekali. Kalau begitu akan kucari sendiri—

column1: (The originally chaotic gale seemed to come alive, transforming into an oppressive storm.)
column2: (Angin kencang yang semula kacau seolah hidup, berubah menjadi badai yang menekan.)

column1: (Immediately after, a massive shadow that blotted out the sky swallowed the entire command room of the Elmo.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, bayangan raksasa yang menutup langit menelan seluruh ruang komando Elmo.)

column1: ("Whoosh—")
column2: ("Wush—")

column1: (The dragon, whose size was now suffocatingly massive, folded its wings in mid-air, tore through the dome, and landed in front of me.)
column2: (Naga yang ukurannya sekarang masif sampai menyesakkan itu melipat sayapnya di udara, mencabik kubahnya, dan mendarat di depanku.)

column1: (And what surprised me the most was that after the dragon landed, a person jumped down from its back—)
column2: (Dan yang paling mengejutkanku, setelah naga itu mendarat, seseorang melompat turun dari punggungnya—)

column1: (No, to be precise, it should be a... "Nyto.")
column2: (Bukan, lebih tepatnya, itu seharusnya seorang... "Nyto.")

column1: Oh my~ It seems all the guests have arrived.
column2: Aduh~ Sepertinya semua tamunya sudah datang.

column1: Are we getting ready to start the ceremony?
column2: Kita sudah siap memulai upacaranya?

column1: Chiloveig... you really didn't die.
column2: Chiloveig... kau memang tidak mati.

column1: Ohohoho~ Sir Knight, we meet again.
column2: Ohohoho~ Tuan Knight, kita bertemu lagi.

column1: Oh my, this is my first time visiting your residence, I hope I'm not intruding~
column2: Aduh, ini kali pertama aku bertamu ke kediamanmu, semoga aku tidak mengganggu~

column1: If I hadn't come in such a hurry, I would have brought a little gift for you, hehe.
column2: Kalau aku tidak datang secepat ini, aku akan membawa hadiah kecil untukmu, hehe.

column1: I wasn't able to host you properly last time we met, I hope you can enjoy yourself to the fullest this time.
column2: Waktu bertemu terakhir aku tidak sempat menjamumu dengan baik, semoga kali ini kau bisa menikmatinya sepenuhnya.

column1: Oh, by the way...
column2: Oh, ngomong-ngomong...

column1: Where have you hidden... the princesses of your household?
column2: Di mana kau menyembunyikan... para putri di rumahmu?

column1: They are no longer called by useless titles like princesses, but warriors.
column2: Mereka tidak lagi dipanggil dengan gelar tak berguna seperti putri, tapi pejuang.

column1: I knew you would be a bad influence on the kids...
column2: Sudah kuduga kau akan jadi pengaruh buruk bagi anak-anak...

column1: Oh my, it seems the household isn't prepared to receive guests~
column2: Aduh, sepertinya rumah ini tidak siap menerima tamu~

column1: Let us help you set out the bowls and chopsticks~ Let's all have a reunion dinner together.
column2: Biar kami membantu menata mangkuk dan sumpitnya~ Mari kita makan malam reuni bersama.

column1: A family should be all together!
column2: Keluarga harus berkumpul semua!

column1: (Chiloveig looks at the giant dragon. After receiving a nod of approval from Ateraxis, it breathes high-temperature fire onto the floor beneath its feet.)

column2: (Saat Chiloveig menjerit, sebuah figur di kejauhan melompat ke dek, mengayunkan pedang besar bergerigi rantai yang matanya berputar, dan cepat memotong sulur yang membelit Soppo, Robella, dan Asteria.)

column1: Sorry I'm late!
column2: Maaf aku terlambat!

column1: Looks like I'm the last one to rejoin the team!
column2: Sepertinya aku yang terakhir bergabung kembali ke tim!

column1: I'm glad...
column2: Aku senang...

column1: Finally here...
column2: Akhirnya datang...

column1: You're still as slow as ever!
column2: Kau tetap lambat seperti dulu!

column1: I got delayed a bit on the way helping to clear the area for everyone on the Elmo.
column2: Aku sedikit tertunda di jalan karena membantu membersihkan area untuk semua orang di Elmo.

column1: But I finally made it!
column2: Tapi akhirnya aku sampai!

column1: RO, what do we do next?
column2: RO, apa langkah kita selanjutnya?

column1: Eh, me?
column2: Eh, aku?

column1: You're the acting captain of the AR Team!
column2: Kau kapten sementara AR Team!

column1: RO, give the orders.
column2: RO, beri perintahnya.

column1: Okay... understood!
column2: Baik... dimengerti!

column1: Let's charge in together and rescue the Commander and everyone!
column2: Mari menerjang bersama dan menyelamatkan Commander serta semuanya!

column1: (Seeing the assembled four-member AR Team, Ateraxis waves her hand again.)
column2: (Melihat AR Team berkumpul lengkap berempat, Ateraxis melambaikan tangannya lagi.)

column1: (The dragon roars, flapping its wings on the deck, but facing Asteria and Soppo, it is clearly somewhat reluctant.)
column2: (Naga itu meraung, mengepakkan sayapnya di dek, tapi menghadapi Asteria dan Soppo, dia jelas agak enggan.)

column1: 奇洛薇格，开始吧。
column2: Chiloveig, mulailah.

column1: 遵命~
column2: Siap~

column1: This time, I'll be much more skilled than before~
column2: Kali ini aku akan jauh lebih mahir dari sebelumnya~

column1: Then, let's start with the consciousness resonance of the Boojum medium~
column2: Kalau begitu, kita mulai dari resonansi kesadaran medium Boojum-nya~

column1: (Chiloveig snaps her fingers.)
column2: (Chiloveig menjentikkan jarinya.)

column1: (As some kind of liquid is pushed through the transport tubes, the light of the "Barracuda" begins to flicker—the flesh of the giant dragon on the deck also begins to mutate, expanding at a visible rate.)
column2: (Saat semacam cairan didorong melalui tabung transpor, cahaya "Barracuda" mulai berkelip—daging naga raksasa di dek itu juga mulai bermutasi, mengembang dengan laju yang terlihat mata.)

column1: Oh no, if this continues, the Elmo will be crushed by this dragon... and Melanie and Helena... won't be able to hold on for much longer.
column2: Gawat, kalau ini berlanjut, Elmo akan dihancurkan naga itu... dan Melanie serta Helena... tidak akan sanggup bertahan lebih lama.

column1: Then let's defeat this guy one more time!
column2: Kalau begitu mari kalahkan dia sekali lagi!

column1: I have a lot of experience with this kind of thing!
column2: Aku punya banyak pengalaman soal hal seperti ini!

column1: M16... no, Beluga, I'm counting on you.
column2: M16... bukan, Beluga, aku mengandalkanmu.

column1: Prioritize the two children. As long as we rescue them, we can disrupt the ritual.
column2: Prioritaskan kedua anak itu. Selama mereka berhasil diselamatkan, ritualnya bisa kita kacaukan.

column1: Yo, Commander~~ Long time no see. I should have had a good drink with you for a night... but I won't say anything to spoil the mood right now.
column2: Yo, Commander~~ Lama tidak bertemu. Aku seharusnya minum-minum semalam denganmu... tapi sekarang aku tidak akan bicara yang merusak suasana.

column1: Leave it to me.
column2: Serahkan padaku.

column1: Since you're arriving so late, you'll have to put in some extra effort.
column2: Karena kau datang selambat itu, kau harus bekerja sedikit lebih keras.

column1: Isn't a comeback battle usually a flashy entrance?
column2: Bukannya pertempuran comeback biasanya entrance yang mencolok?

column1: Why are you fighting so tragically, Asteria~?
column2: Kenapa pertarunganmu tragis begitu, Asteria~?

column1: You're so noisy!
column2: Kau berisik sekali!

column1: (Given the power Ateraxis displayed earlier, I know she isn't truly seeking my "permission".)
column2: (Dengan kekuatan yang ditunjukkan Ateraxis tadi, aku tahu dia sebenarnya tidak mencari "izin"-ku.)

column1: (Rather, at this moment, she seems more intent on convincing me, proving the correctness of her actions—like a child craving an adult's affirmation, confirming that she hasn't done anything wrong.)
column2: (Justru saat ini dia tampak lebih ingin meyakinkanku, membuktikan tindakannya benar—seperti anak yang mendambakan pengakuan orang dewasa, memastikan dia tidak melakukan kesalahan.)

column1: (Thinking about it carefully, her birth was not that long ago. The goal instilled by Caldwell is the reason she believes she was created. In this regard, she is no different from Dolls acting according to their underlying logic.)
column2: (Kalau dipikir-pikir, kelahirannya belum lama. Tujuan yang ditanamkan Caldwell adalah alasan yang dia yakini sebagai sebab dia diciptakan. Dalam hal ini, dia tidak berbeda dari Doll yang bertindak menurut logika dasarnya.)

column1: (I can only explain to her with words—in the past, in Frankfurt, one man's madness ultimately led to the deaths of millions.)
column2: (Aku hanya bisa menjelaskannya dengan kata-kata—dulu di Frankfurt, kegilaan satu orang akhirnya menewaskan jutaan nyawa.)

column1: (The struggle over the power of the Relics and Nirvana is essentially just a continuation of the struggle for power. Even if Ateraxis has no subjective malice, it cannot change the desires of her creator and others.)
column2: (Perebutan kekuatan Relics dan Nirvana pada dasarnya hanya kelanjutan perebutan kuasa. Meski Ateraxis tidak punya niat jahat secara pribadi, itu tidak mengubah hasrat penciptanya dan yang lain.)

column1: (Ateraxis shook her head, interrupting my admonition.)
column2: (Ateraxis menggeleng, memotong nasihatku.)

column1: (In the end, how many people would be sacrificed, and how much suitable living environment humanity would lose, was simply not worth mentioning in her and Caldwell's thoughts.)
column2: (Pada akhirnya, berapa banyak orang yang akan dikorbankan, dan seberapa besar lingkungan hidup layak yang akan hilang bagi manusia, sama sekali tidak layak disebut dalam pikirannya dan Caldwell.)

column1: (For Asteria, who wanted to see M4 more than anyone else, yet followed her wishes by stopping anyone from going to Nirvana and opening the door, Ateraxis's words were undoubtedly a great irony and provocation.)
column2: (Bagi Asteria yang lebih dari siapa pun ingin menemui M4, tapi menuruti keinginannya dengan mencegah siapa pun pergi ke Nirvana dan membuka pintunya, kata-kata Ateraxis tidak diragukan adalah ironi besar dan provokasi.)

column1: (Her anger made even Ateraxis stop in her tracks, unable to ignore it.)
column2: (Kemarahannya bahkan membuat Ateraxis berhenti melangkah, tidak bisa mengabaikannya.)

column1: (Although I don't reject relics to such an extreme degree, there is one thing I am certain of: we in this era are absolutely not ready to open it yet.)
column2: (Meski aku tidak menolak relic sampai seekstrem itu, ada satu hal yang kuyakini: kami di era ini sama sekali belum siap membukanya.)

column1: (Furthermore, I don't believe for a second that Caldwell's creation can open that door without paying a price, like "she" did.)
column2: (Lebih dari itu, aku sedikit pun tidak percaya ciptaan Caldwell bisa membuka pintu itu tanpa membayar harga, seperti yang dilakukan "dia".)

column1: (Even just considering the collateral damage her forced entry into Nirvana might cause to the real world, I cannot agree to let go.)
column2: (Bahkan hanya dengan memikirkan kerusakan sampingan yang mungkin ditimbulkan pemaksaan masuknya ke Nirvana terhadap dunia nyata, aku tidak bisa setuju untuk melepaskannya.)
